verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show models being downloaded with 'ollama pull', removed with 'ollama rm', and run with 'ollama run' (including --verbose benchmarking). Users single out model management as Ollama's key strength, and the GitHub README shows running library models from the command line. Missing for 10: any evidence of CLI-based model search/discovery, first-party CLI reference docs for pull/rm/list commands.
